verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own `local-ai chat` agent reads your files and answers questions about them, and its built-in web interface lets you chat with models. That is first-party AI analysis of user data, but nothing documents dedicated proactive insights or suggestions drawn from data held in the product. Missing for 10: a documented insights/suggestions feature over user data, depth of data analysis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine
local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models
